Coerce a value to logical

Source: R/util_boolean_check.R
util_boolean_check.Rd

Converts any representation of TRUE/FALSE (logical, character, or numeric) to a proper R logical value. Returns FALSE for NA, empty string, or NULL.

Usage

util_boolean_check(x)

Arguments

x

A scalar: logical, character ("TRUE", "FALSE", "true", "T", "1") or numeric (1, 0).

Value

A single logical value (TRUE or FALSE).

Examples

SEMseeker:::util_boolean_check("TRUE")   # TRUE
#> [1] TRUE
SEMseeker:::util_boolean_check("false")  # FALSE
#> [1] FALSE
SEMseeker:::util_boolean_check(1)        # TRUE
#> [1] TRUE
SEMseeker:::util_boolean_check(NA)       # FALSE
#> [1] FALSE
